name: IressAlert
description: Communicates important information inline with page content, such as validation errors, warnings, or status messages.

name: IressAutocomplete
description: Provides a text input with suggestions that filter as the user types.

name: IressButtonGroup
description: Groups related buttons together with consistent spacing and alignment.

name: IressButton
description: A clickable element used to perform an action.

name: IressCard
description: Groups related content and actions into a contained, visually distinct surface.

name: IressCheckboxGroup
description: Groups related checkboxes so users can select multiple options from a set.

name: IressCheckbox
description: Renders a checkbox input for toggling a boolean value.

name: IressCol
description: Defines a column within a grid row layout.

name: IressContainer
description: Provides a max-width wrapper to constrain content within a page layout.

name: IressDivider
description: Renders a horizontal or vertical line to visually separate content.

name: IressExpander
description: Reveals or hides a section of content with an expand/collapse toggle.

name: IressFieldGroup
description: Groups related form fields together with a shared legend, description, and validation message.

name: IressField
description: Wraps a form control with its label, description, and validation message.

name: IressHide
description: Conditionally hides content based on responsive breakpoints.

name: IressIcon
description: Renders an SVG icon from the design system icon set.

name: IressImage
description: Renders a responsive image with optional fallback and loading behaviour.

name: IressInline
description: Lays out children horizontally with consistent spacing between items.

name: IressInputCurrency
description: Provides a text input formatted for entering monetary values.

name: IressInput
description: Renders a single-line text input for capturing user data.

name: IressLabel
description: Provides an accessible text label for a form control.

name: IressLink
description: Renders a navigational anchor styled consistently with the design system.

name: IressMenu
description: Displays a list of navigational or actionable items.

name: IressModal
description: Displays content in a focused overlay dialog that requires user interaction.

name: IressPanel
description: Provides a sectioned container for grouping related content with an optional heading.

name: IressPill
description: Displays a small, rounded badge for categorisation or status indication.

name: IressPlaceholder
description: Renders a visual placeholder to represent future or missing content.

name: IressPopover
description: Displays floating content anchored to a trigger element.

name: IressProgress
description: Visualises the completion status of a task or process as a progress bar.

name: IressProvider

name: IressRadioGroup
description: Groups related radio buttons so users can select one option from a set.

name: IressRadio
description: Renders a single radio button for use within a group of mutually exclusive options.

name: IressReadonly
description: Displays a form value in a non-editable, read-only format.

name: IressRow
description: Arranges children in a horizontal row within a grid or flex layout.

name: IressSelect
description: Renders a dropdown select input for choosing one option from a list.

name: IressSkeleton
description: Renders placeholder shapes to indicate content is loading.

name: IressSkipLink

name: IressSlideout
description: Displays supplementary content in a panel that slides in from the edge of the viewport.

name: IressSlider
description: Allows users to select a value from a range by dragging a handle.

name: IressSpinner
description: Displays an animated loading indicator to signal an ongoing process.

name: IressStack
description: Lays out children vertically with consistent spacing between items.

name: IressStyled
description: A polymorphic utility component that applies design tokens and styling props to any HTML element or custom component.

name: IressTabSet
description: Organises content into tabbed panels, showing one panel at a time.

name: IressTable
description: Displays structured data in rows and columns.

name: IressTag
description: Displays a compact label for categorisation, filtering, or metadata.

name: IressText
description: Renders styled text with consistent typography from the design system.

name: IressToaster
description: Manages and displays temporary toast notifications to the user.

name: IressToggle
description: Renders a switch control for toggling between on and off states.

name: IressTooltip
description: Shows additional contextual information on hover or focus of a trigger element.

name: IressValidationMessage
description: Displays a validation error or helper message associated with a form field.

name: IressBreadcrumbs
description: Shows the current location within a navigational hierarchy.

name: IressContextualMenu
description: Displays a context-sensitive menu of actions triggered by user interaction.

name: IressDropdownMenu
description: Presents a list of actions or options revealed by a trigger button.

name: IressFeedback
description: Displays transient feedback messages to communicate the result of an action.

name: IressForm
description: Manages form state, validation, and submission for a group of input fields.

name: IressLoading
description: Displays a loading state to indicate content is being fetched or processed.

name: IressShadow

name: IressSideNav
description: Provides a vertical navigation menu typically used in application sidebars.
